launches.title: RamAIn: Teach AI to use your legacy systems, desktop applications and web portals just like a human
launches.tagline: With AI, we handle complex data entry and extraction operations on which RPA breaks. 10x faster than computer use agents from Google, OpenAI and Anthropic.
launches.body:
# \*\*\*\*

**tl;dr: [RamAIn](https://www.ramain.ai/)** _intelligently_ _automates complex and repetitive work across browser and desktop applications. It doesn’t matter if you have API access or not - the general principle is: **if you can see it, RamAIn can do it.**_

[RamAIn Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tnVTskMw3mk)

Enterprise teams are stuck **manually reading, copy-pasting and tab-switching** for hours every week. RamAIn kills the busywork so your team can get back to the real work.

RamAIn agents simulate mouse and keyboard clicks to use your team’s computers just like a human to move data between your **legacy systems, desktop applications and web portals.** It dominates complex data entry and extraction tasks through UI-interaction on which traditional RPA breaks.

RamAIn is **self-healing** and great at handling unexpected pop-ups or UI changes by using AI to solve for deviations it hasn’t seen before. It takes just a **few days to train and deploy** across your team’s applications and maintains a full audit-trail of decisions.

Unlike current computer-use AI agents that have to think about every action while executing, **RamAIn learns UI-policies and interface structures** from your key interfaces that allows it to make decisions 10x faster while being super reliable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97571&key=user_uploads/2267746/6806e0de-aca0-4f07-a2c4-5a8c2a53408f)

_What RamAIn sees after it has learnt how to use Outlook_

RamAIn is super-safe. It comes out of the box with human-in-the-loop support, giving your team real-time control over every workflow. It’s designed to augment your team, boosting productivity without replacing human expertise.

Through a simple UI overlay, RamAIn can communicate with your team in real-time, asking clarifying questions whenever context is missing or expert judgment is required.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97571&key=user_uploads/2267746/0f41ab6f-7efb-4316-a522-2cafe22191a2)

_RamAIn requesting human-input in assisted mode_

RamAIn unifies automations into a single agent by integrating with APIs when required and using UI-interaction where APIs aren’t available to ensure complete task coverage across both internal and 3rd-party systems.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97571&key=user_uploads/2267746/fc2923e3-da81-4140-a931-9f2964350517)

_RamAIn filling up a dynamic 3rd-party form in real-time_

**We’ve learnt through our customers that RamAIn is perfect for -**

**Procurement Teams:** \
_(ERP + Supplier Portals)_\
Vendor onboarding, PO creation, invoice matching, supplier data entry.

**Insurance Brokers:** \
_(Carrier Portals + Brokering Platforms)_\
Submit client intake across carrier portals, extract quotes, compare premiums, update internal systems.

**Healthcare Providers:** \
_(EHRs + Lab & Payer Portals)_\
Transfer patient data between intake forms, manage prior authorizations, coordinate labs and payers.

**Revenue Cycle Management Teams:** \
_(RCM Platforms + Payer Portals)_\
Eligibility checks, claim submissions, denial follow-ups, payment posting, EOB reconciliation.

**Finance & Operations Teams:** \
_(ERP + Legacy Finance Systems)_\
AP/AR automation, reconciliations, reporting, inventory updates.

**Retail & Store Operations:** \
_(POS + Accounting Systems)_\
Sales reconciliation, pricing updates, transaction reporting.

**Pharmacy Operations:**\
_(Pharmacy Management Systems + Distributor Portals)_\
Prescription processing, insurance claim submission, inventory reconciliation.

**Logistics & Transportation Teams:** \
_(TMS + Carrier Portals)_\
Load booking, carrier updates, shipment tracking, document uploads, freight invoice reconciliation.

**Is your team also drowning in manual labour?**
